description: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.
transcript: Hmm, this one. We have a deal.

en.question: What is the man in white doing?

de.answer: Er besiegelt eine Vereinbarung mit einem Händedruck.
de.question: Was macht der Mann in Weiß?

es.answer: Está cerrando un acuerdo con un apretón de manos.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre de blanco?

fr.answer: Il scelle un accord par une poignée de main.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme en blanc ?
